first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and dataset-specific confirmation of the official coordinate reference system for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official Spatial NI Data Supply: Metadata window documents the Spatial NI data-supply metadata field for spatial reference system and exposes Irish Grid (TM65) [EPSG:29902] as an official data-supply reference-system option. Because this is a generic Spatial NI supply form rather than metadata bound specifically to the Belfast City 2006 LiDAR resource, EPSG:29902 is retained only as an official candidate and is not asserted as the dataset CRS; no tile filename, geometry, parcel binding or dataset-specific CRS is fabricated.
